did_you_know.text: Did you know? Ahaziah became king of Judah even though he was Jehoram’s youngest son, after his older brothers were killed in a raid by a band of men who had come to the camp with the Arabs.
Did you know? According to 2 Chronicles, Ahaziah reigned in Jerusalem for only one year, and his mother was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri.
Did you know? The text says that Ahaziah followed the ways of the house of Ahab, and that his mother Athaliah advised him and urged him to do evil.
Did you know? After his father’s death, Ahaziah had advisers from the house of Ahab, and the text says that their advice led him to ruin.
Did you know? Ahaziah joined Jehoram son of Ahab, king of Israel, in a war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead; during the war, Jehoram was wounded.
Did you know? After Jehoram returned to Jezreel to recover, Ahaziah went there to visit him, and was caught up in the events that led to the destruction of the house of Ahab.
Did you know? The text presents Ahaziah’s meeting with Jehoram and Jehu as part of Ahaziah’s downfall, because Jehu had been anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.
Did you know? When Jehu attacked the house of Ahab, he also killed the officials of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers, who were serving Ahaziah.

Did you know? Ahaziah hid in Samaria, was captured, and was killed by Jehu’s men; he was buried because he was the son of Jehoshaphat, who was remembered as one who sought the Lord with all his heart.
Did you know? After Ahaziah’s death, Athaliah tried to destroy all the royal descendants of the house of Judah in order to establish her rule.
Did you know? Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter and Ahaziah’s sister, rescued Joash, Ahaziah’s son, and hid him and his nurse from Athaliah.
Did you know? Joash was hidden in the house of God for six years under the protection of Jehoshabeath and Jehoiada the priest, while Athaliah ruled over the land.
